observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a complete 4-cylinder engine bay/engine assembly on a floor, with intake/exhaust manifolds, fuel/ignition components, and visible pulleys (including a crank pulley and accessory belt system).
There is no clearly readable engine model/part number, VIN, or nameplate in either photo.
The seller’s text overlay watermark is visible, but it does not provide an engine identity that can be read from the photos.

claims.evidence: Brand/model markings are not readable in photo 0 or photo 1.
No import documents, shipping labels, or readable markings indicating Belgium in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly but do not show a running test, compression/leak test results, or evidence of whether it has been opened (photo 0/1 do not show tamper-proof seals, opened fasteners, or test logs).

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model is not readable, so the price could be wrong for the actual variant (and parts availability/cost in Lagos).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine ID plate/sticker or stamped engine code (block head area) plus the full engine bay label; also a photo of the gearbox mating area showing the engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown 4-cylinder used engine with no confirmed specs (worst-case fitment/unknown variant).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” is not verifiable from still photos; internal damage (bore scoring, bearing wear) may exist.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the engine running from cold start (idle + brief rev), plus a mechanic’s sound check note (or a phone recording of the test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst-case treated as needing inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: “Never opened” is not verifiable; head gasket or internal work could have been done and then resealed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cylinder head bolts/torque marks, gasket surfaces, and any tamper evidence; plus photos of timing cover area and oil pan gasket edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially opened/unknown history (worst-case: not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Mileage claim is unverifiable; odometer/ECU mileage may not match engine wear.
risks.proof: Photo of ECU/cluster mileage readout (if available) or any sticker/label showing mileage at removal; also a compression test sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price without mileage premium (worst-case: average wear).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: engine may not match the buyer’s car (mounts, sensors, wiring harness, ECU, intake/exhaust configuration).
risks.proof: Photos of engine mounts, sensor connectors, and the exact part numbers for ECU/major sensors; plus the donor vehicle model/year.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification for fitment (worst-case: buyer may need extra parts).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code on the block/head (the part that determines exact model).
Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) showing no abnormal knocking and stable idle.
Compression test and/or leak-down test results (photos of the gauge readings).
Close-up photos showing whether it has been opened: head bolt area, timing cover area, gasket edges, and any tamper evidence.
Donor vehicle details (make/model/year) and photos of key connectors/mounts for compatibility.
response.reason: From the photos, the engine’s exact identity (brand/model/engine code) and the seller’s “tested/working, no knock, never opened, low mileage” claims cannot be verified remotely. Without the engine code and proof of running/compression, a confident worst-case price can’t be set reliably.
